summary: Second appeal under CPC s.100; substantial questions of law must precede hearing; High Court erred in reversing concurrent factual findings without framing questions; absence of trial record in reassessing readiness/willingness; specific performance; limitation; reversal of factual findings improper absent perversity; appellate jurisdiction boundaries.
legal_provisions_cited: Ravi Setia v. Madan Lal (2019) 9 SCC 381
Sukhbir Singh v. Brij Pal Singh (1997) 2 SCC 200
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; concurrent findings restored; specific performance suit revived with direction to deposit Rs.6 lakh.
